title: Split OpenCode config tests out of acp_gemini.rs
outcome: Purely move the cohesive OpenCode dynamic-config test suite (ordering, post-model waits, timeouts, partial refresh, rejection, and option reconciliation) from src/tests/acp_gemini.rs into src/tests/opencode_config.rs and wire the module in src/tests/mod.rs. Preserve behavior and test names; keep this separate from feature changes.
acceptance: On master, the OpenCode dynamic-config test suite lives in src/tests/opencode_config.rs, registered by `mod opencode_config;` in src/tests/mod.rs, and src/tests/acp_gemini.rs contains no test function whose name begins with opencode_ (struct fields such as opencode_mode are not tests).

Every opencode_ test that was in src/tests/acp_gemini.rs before the split exists on master under its original name, or under a recorded rename made by the commit that moved it; the two renames in 6e9b1b87 are recorded on this item.
The move was not a separate pure-move commit: it landed inside feature commit 6e9b1b87. This is recorded as accepted history, not reworked.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure. The OpenCode config test suite moved from src/tests/acp_gemini.rs into src/tests/opencode_config.rs, registered in src/tests/mod.rs, inside feature commit 6e9b1b87 (an ancestor of master 1495e8d3). All 19 original tests are on master, 2 of them under renames recorded on the item. The missing separate pure-move commit is accepted as history (Fable2 concurrence d974dda1). Independent evaluation 3f3c4c0f passed 3/3.
